items.reason: The new handler sets only `uid: booking.uid`, omitting persisted `iCalUID`, and passes that event to the email sender (packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:137,168). Guest-update attachments use generateIcsString (packages/emails/templates/attendee-add-guests-email.ts:10), whose UID fallback is `event.iCalUID || event.uid` (packages/emails/lib/generateIcsString.ts:67). This changes calendar identity for ordinary bookings because getICalUID generates `${uid}@${APP_NAME}` (packages/emails/lib/getICalUID.ts:30), preventing invitations from updating the original event.
